general.title: Need Help?
general.description: We're here to help you make the most of Tablawy OS. Explore the guides below.

steps.title: Check Notifications
steps.description: Click the bell icon to see important alerts from your teachers and AI.

steps.title: Quick Actions
steps.description: Use the command menu (Ctrl + K) to navigate anywhere instantly.

tips: Change your language anytime in the top header.
Your XP progress is always visible at the top.

studyLab.title: AI Study Lab
studyLab.description: Master any topic with your private AI-powered learning space.

steps.title: Pick a Tool
steps.description: Choose between Explain, Quiz, Summarize, or Flashcards based on your goal.

steps.title: Provide Context
steps.description: Paste your notes or type a specific topic to let Gemini analyze it.

steps.title: Active Recall
steps.description: Use the generated flashcards or quizzes to test your knowledge and earn XP.

tips: Summarize long text first to get the key points before generating quizzes.
Flashcards use Spaced Repetition to help you remember longer.

classHub.title: Class Management
classHub.description: Welcome to your class command center. Here you can manage students, curriculum, and assignments.

steps.title: Add Students
steps.description: Use the People tab to enroll students or generate a join code.

steps.title: Build Curriculum
steps.description: Organize your lessons and resources into modules.

steps.title: Track Progress
steps.description: Monitor student engagement and grade submissions in real-time.

tips: You can use the Magic Builder to generate module drafts instantly.
Pin important announcements to keep them at the top of the feed.

dashboard.title: Dashboard Hub
dashboard.description: This is your academic command center. Here's how to use it:

steps.title: The 'What's Next' Widget
steps.description: Check the cards at the top for urgent tasks like grading or assignments.

steps.title: Track Progress
steps.description: Scroll down to see your academic journey charts and recent activity.

tips: The 'At-Risk' section on the right is prioritized by AI.
Click any activity log item to go directly to that resource.

classCurriculum.title: Managing Curriculum
classCurriculum.description: Organize your lessons into modules and materials.

steps.title: Create a Module
steps.description: Click 'Add Module' to start a new chapter or topic section.

steps.title: Use AI Magic Builder
steps.description: Use the purple 'Wand' icon to generate an entire curriculum automatically.

tips: You can drag and drop modules to reorder them.
Mark items as 'Draft' to hide them from students until they are ready.

createAssignment.title: Creating Tasks
createAssignment.description: Design engaging assignments for your students.

steps.title: Set a Rubric
steps.description: Add grading criteria (e.g., Grammar, Logic) so students know what to expect.

steps.title: AI Assistant
steps.description: Use the AI writing assistant to draft instructions based on your topic.

steps.title: Publish Task
steps.description: Once ready, click the main button to notify all students.

tips: Setting a clear deadline helps students prioritize their work.
Attach reference materials to help students complete the task.

classAttendance.title: Attendance Tracking
classAttendance.description: Monitor and record student presence in your classroom.

steps.title: Manual Marking
steps.description: Click the status icon next to a student's name to toggle between Present, Absent, or Late.

steps.title: QR Check-in
steps.description: Start a QR session to let students mark themselves present using their phones.

steps.title: Export Reports
steps.description: Use the export button to download a full attendance sheet for the term.

tips: QR sessions are time-limited for security.
You can add remarks to any attendance record for future reference.

quizzes.title: Quizzes & Assessments
quizzes.description: Test knowledge with interactive AI-powered quizzes.

steps.title: Generate with AI
steps.description: Paste your lesson notes and let AI create multiple-choice questions instantly.

steps.title: Review Results
steps.description: See a detailed breakdown of which questions students struggled with most.

tips: Shuffle questions to prevent students from seeing the same order.
Add explanations to each question to help students learn from their mistakes.

library.title: Global Library
library.description: Your personal cloud for all teaching resources.

steps.title: Upload Once
steps.description: Upload a file to your library to use it in any of your classes without re-uploading.

steps.title: Organize by Topic
steps.description: Add descriptions to your resources to find them easily later.

tips: You can share library links directly with other teachers.
The library supports PDFs, Videos, and common Office documents.

magicBuilder.description: Generate an entire curriculum module instantly using Gemini AI.
